A [[Warthog (species)|Warthog]] served as a '''pirate''' onboard [[Captain]] [[Gorian Shard]]'s [[Cumulus-class Corsair|''Cumulus''-class Corsair]].<ref name="Chapter 17" />

==Biography==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> this Warthog [[pirate]] served as the [[Helm officer|helmsman]] for [[Pirate King]] Gorian Shard's personal [[Gorian Shard's pirate Corsair|''Cumulus''-class Corsair]]. In that [[Standard year|year]], [[Vane]], a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] pirate, and several other pirates were being [[Dogfight in the Nevarro system|chased]] by the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]]. Vane, who was the only survivor of the ambush, retreated to Shard's Corsair as Djarin's [[N-1 starfighter]] approached the colossus [[Starship|ship]].<ref name="Chapter 17" />

As Shard and Djarin discussed their quarrel, the Warthog pirate stood at the helm of the ship as the pirate watched the heated argument. Djarin, who gave [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] advise to never trust a pirate, used his [[sublight engine]]s to escape Shard and his [[Gorian Shard's pirate crew|pirate gang]].<ref name="Chapter 17" />

Later, Shard and his pirate gang invaded the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]] after Shard's [[Gorian Shard's helmsman|helmsman]] was gunned down by [[High Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]]. Mad, Shard commenced an [[aerial bombardment]] of [[Nevarro City]], forcing Karga and many civilians to escape to the [[lava fields]]. In a desperate hope, Karga contacted the [[New Republic]] for assistance with the matter. His message would be received by [[Carson Teva]], who later asked Djarin and the [[Children of the Watch]] to dispatch the pirate gang.<ref name="Chapter 21" />

After a debate, Djarin and [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] [[Pirate siege on Nevarro|battled]] with the pirate gang on the planet. During the battle, the Warthog pirate piloted Shard's Corsair, as Shard barked orders at his [[Ugnaught]] [[Unidentified pirate coxswain|coxswain]]. After all [[Cumulus-class snub fighter|Snub Fighters]] were destroyed, except for Vane who abandoned Shard and his crew, the coxswain told Shard that they should retreat. Shard, who refused to retreat, pushed the Warthog pirate out of the way as he made one last effort to [[Death|kill]] Djarin and Kryze, but the two Mandalorians destroyed his last engine, which sent Shard, the Warthog pirate, and the rest of the crew crashing down onto Nevarro's surface.<ref name="Chapter 21" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Warthog pirate first appeared in "[[Chapter 17: The Apostate]]," the seventeenth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Rick Famuyiwa]].<ref name="Chapter 17" /> [[Ian Goodwin]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Chapter 17" />
